description: Write the answer for an external stage into the run folder, then resume the run in the background. The stage must be one external_prompt lists under `waiting`; the run resumes once all of them are answered. claimed_by is optional (v3 §1): a self-declared peer-session name, recorded as this stage's claim; every check here is warn-only and never blocks the write, so a caller that omits it sees exactly today's behavior. answered_model is optional: the model that wrote this answer, as you know it (for example claude-opus-5-5 or gpt-6.1). It is recorded as your own statement and is never checked; leave it out if you do not know.

answered_model.description: the model that wrote this answer, in your own words; recorded as declared, never verified

claimed_by.description: self-declared peer-session name, recorded as this stage's claim before the answer is written

name: submit_stage
